description: Historical DNS resolutions for a domain or IP from Mnemonic's keyless Passive DNS: the answers a name resolved to over time (or the names that pointed at an IP), each with a first/last-seen window and observation count. Surfaces old/rotated infrastructure a live lookup can't. Reads the passive-DNS database, never the target. Read-only.

query.description: Domain or IP, e.g. example.com or 1.2.3.4

name: passive_dns
